87:16.text: Nay, you prefer the life of this world,

87:17.text: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

87:18.text: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures -

88:1.text: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming

88:2.text: Some faces, that Day will be humiliated
(in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians)

88:3.text: (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allâh)
(in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace)

88:4.text: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire.

88:5.text: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,

88:6.text: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,

88:7.text: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

88:8.text: faces that Day will be joyful,

88:9.text: (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism)

88:11.text: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.

88:12.text: Therein will be a running spring.

88:13.text: Therein will be thrones raised high.

88:17.text: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?

88:18.text: And at the heaven, how it is raised?

88:19.text: And at the mountains, how they are rooted

88:20.text: And at the earth, how it is outspread?

88:21.text: - you are only one who reminds.

88:22.text: You are not a dictator over them -

88:23.text: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.

88:24.text: Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

88:25.text: Verily, to Us will be their return;

88:26.text: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.
